data_package.title: NPS Visitor Use Statistics Data Package, 2025

selected_file.description: Primary monthly visitation dataset by unit code and statistic

method_note: NPS page inspected with Requests + BeautifulSoup. The Power BI dashboard is JavaScript-driven and was not scraped. Exactly one official CSV (Main_Data.csv) was retrieved from the official IRMA DataStore REST API. The package ends at the latest finalized calendar year; current-year preliminary data are excluded.

robots_notes.crawling_datastore_download_disallowed: Adhered to by querying metadata through public REST API endpoint instead of scraping web interface

citation: Ziesler, P. 2026. NPS Visitor Use Statistics Data Package, 2025. National Park Service. Fort Collins CO. https://doi.org/10.57830/2317666
